name: Weichai Power Co., Ltd.
summary: Weichai Power Co., Ltd. engages in the automobile and equipment manufacturing industry in China and internationally. The company operates through the Engines, Automobiles and Auto Parts, Agricultural Equipment, and Intelligent Logistics segments. It offers engines for trucks, buses, construction machinery, and agricultural tractors and harvesters; energy and power solutions, including generator sets and industrial power products; transmission, PTO, and auto transmission products; axles for trucks, buses, and construction machineries; and hydraulics comprising variable displacement pumps, VT modular valves, electronic units, and excavator and agriculture machine powertrain systems.
